mapper.update: UPDATE pay_trade_order SET pay_status = '1', trade_status = 'PAID', channel_order_no = #{channelOrderNo}, pay_success_time = #{paySuccessTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pay_status = '0' AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE pay_trade_order SET trade_status = 'SUBMITTING', prepay_time = NOW(), err_code = NULL, err_msg = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pay_status = '0' AND del_flag = '0' AND (trade_status IN ('PENDING', 'UNKNOWN') OR trade_status IS NULL)
UPDATE pay_trade_order SET trade_status = 'PENDING', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pay_status = '0' AND trade_status = 'SUBMITTING' AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE pay_trade_order SET trade_status = 'UNKNOWN', err_code = #{errCode}, err_msg = #{errMsg}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pay_status = '0' AND trade_status IN ('SUBMITTING', 'PENDING', 'CLOSING') AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE pay_trade_order SET trade_status = 'CLOSING', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pay_status = '0' AND trade_status IN ('PENDING', 'UNKNOWN') AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE pay_trade_order SET trade_status = 'CLOSING', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pay_status = '0' AND del_flag = '0' AND (trade_status IN ('PENDING', 'UNKNOWN') OR trade_status IS NULL OR (trade_status = 'CLOSING' AND update_time < #{staleBefore}))

UPDATE pay_trade_order SET trade_status = 'CLOSED', close_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pay_status = '0' AND trade_status IN ('CLOSING', 'PENDING', 'UNKNOWN') AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE pay_trade_order SET config_revision_id = #{revisionId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = '0' AND (config_revision_id IS NULL OR config_revision_id = '')
